title: Kill old PipeShare splash cloud+pipe logo
description:
Portal intro splash was showing the old cloud+pipe / AUTOMATED PIPELINE MANAGEMENT mark because the zero-seam video path resolved under /client-portal/assets (404) and fell back to brand-pipeshare-transparent.png. Fixes video/poster to ../assets/, replaces those PNGs with the zero-seam poster, and hard cache-busts the portal.

Who is affected: anyone opening PipeShare client portal splash on BASE/SaaS.
changeLog: Replace brand-pipeshare-transparent.png (and siblings) with zero-seam poster
